name: Goal Rings
description: Concentric rings that sweep towards each goal on pale tracks, with a tile per ring above them.

props.name: rings
props.type: { name: string; value: number; goal: number; color?: string; format?: (value: number) => string }[]
props.description: One ring per entry, outermost first. A ring sweeps value ÷ goal of a turn and laps itself in a deeper shade past the goal. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the outer ring in pixels. Shrinks to fit a narrow card.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Show a tile per ring above the rings with its colour, name and formatted value.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the rings when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts value, delta, caption, note, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
